account_usd.description: Account size in USD (optional; enables units, notional, leverage)

risk_pct.description: Percent of the account risked if the stop is hit (default 1)

stop_atr.description: Stop distance in ATR(14) multiples when no stop is given (default 2)

symbol.description: Base asset ticker, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE (BTC-PERP, ETH-USD and SOLUSDT are accepted too)
